verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting and gateway platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only browser, web and config-paste workflows and never describes an official Glama CLI. The mention of tunneling local servers via mcp-proxy does not establish a first-party Glama CLI, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
